name: ip101
title: IC Plus IP101 Ethernet PHY

facts.source: esp_eth_phy_ip101.c of ESP-IDF 5.5.5: the OUI 0x90C3 and model 5 of IC Plus, the registers of IEEE 802.3

notes: A 10/100 PHY with the registers of IEEE 802.3, so the generic PHY driver of ESP-IDF runs it. ESP-IDF 6 moved its own IP101 driver out, to espressif/ip101 of the registry.
The JC1060P470C answered over MDIO with the id 0243 0c54: IC Plus, model 5.
